draft.title: Operations Supervisor
draft.position_summary: Responsible for the administration of the physical plant, mail services, room set-ups, warehouse/stores, shipping and receiving services and staff supervision of the Harbour Centre Campus.

duties.statement: Responsible for the daily operation of the facility by ensuring that contracted electrical, mechanical, maintenance, elevator, escalator and other facility services are provided to ensure that the building is fully operational for each day of business and that a high standard is maintained with respect to the general appearance of the campus. Responsible for the daily administration of mail services, warehouse/stores and shipping and receiving to support the activities of the building. Responsible for monitoring the janitorial contract and services by checking the general appearance of the facility to ensure services are provided efficiently, consistently and cost-effectively in order to maintain a high standard of cleanliness. Responsible for ensuring the daily provision of room set-up services and other activities by liaising with Meeting and Event Services, Information/Registration, Continuing Studies and other departments and coordinating janitorial and operations services in order to provide effective support to the variety of events being held on the campus. Evaluates, reviews and makes recommendations to the Operations Manager for the more effective provision of the services

model.title: Operations Supervisor
model.position_summary: The Operations Supervisor ensures the Harbour Centre Campus facilities and support services operate efficiently and maintain a high standard of appearance, providing essential administrative and logistical support to campus activities. This role oversees contracted building services, manages mail, warehouse and shipping functions, monitors janitorial performance, coordinates room set‑up and event support, and evaluates service delivery to recommend improvements and budgetary actions. By collaborating with internal departments and contract providers, the supervisor helps sustain a safe, functional, and welcoming environment for staff, students, and visitors.
